calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Ryzon
calls.summary: The discussion focused on enhancing Ryzen's testing capabilities by transitioning to Growth Book's server-side testing for improved personalization, addressing limitations faced with AB Tasty's client-side features. Key points included Growth Book's expanded analytics, AI integration for simplified experimentation, and a competitive pricing model based on experiments rather than website traffic. Integration with Ryzen's existing tech stack, including Shopify and BigQuery, was detailed, ensuring seamless adoption. An enterprise support model offering 24/7 assistance and onboarding was highlighted, alongside plans for a technical review scheduled for May 19th to validate implementation feasibility and secure internal buy-in.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Server-Side Testing, Personalization, Shopify SDK, BigQuery Integration, AI-Powered Analytics
